verdict.rationale: Stripe documents registrable HTTPS webhook endpoints that receive real-time event pushes, and Terminal payments live in the same Stripe API alongside refunds and disputes. So programmatic event subscription is the product's own capability. However, the evidence never names the specific lifecycle event types or ties webhook events to Terminal in-person payments. Missing for 10: documented event types for authorized, captured, refunded and disputed; Terminal-specific webhook docs; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to payment lifecycle events (authorized, captured, refunded, disputed) via webhooks to drive downstream automations

citations.quote: After you register a webhook endpoint, Stripe pushes real-time data to it when events occur.
You can issue refunds by using the Refunds API or the Dashboard.
you can accept in-person payments and manage them alongside your online payments in Stripe
